---
applyTo: "packages/content/**,apps/web/src/content/**"
---
- Never imply AI writes anything. We never rewrite a person's words.
- Celebrate what exists. Never count gaps or loss. No streaks, points or badges.
- Never gender the child; use `{child}`.
- No em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis characters or emoji.
- If a content rule test fails, fix the copy, not the test.
